'''Volume 15''' is the fifteenth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. As part of VIZ Media's ''Pokémon Black and White'' series, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
